fixture_status: Fictional product fixture for a neutral public example repository. Not a real product.
tagline: Calm environmental telemetry for quiet workspaces.
raw_baseline_brief: Create a clean product visual for DATUM-01, a minimalist desktop climate monitor and companion app.

alabaster.role: primary background ground: matte warm ceramic and seamless backdrop

stone.role: secondary neutral surface: panels, cards, and desk ground

aluminum.role: brushed metal neutral: bezels, trim, and edge highlights

ink.role: matte charcoal graphite: device face, type-free UI ink, and shadow anchors

terra.role: single signature anodized terracotta accent: one dot or status indicator per frame

lighting: Soft directional morning daylight from camera-left, matte surfaces, subtle architectural shadows, no neon glow, no text or watermarks.
negative_constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no neon glow, no purple or cyan lighting, no glossy CGI plastic, no floating particles
